# FIS-B fixtures

## tg30.978

- **Origin:** fisb-decode, https://github.com/rand-projects/fisb-decode,
  file `tg/tg-source/generated/tg30.978`. Taken from a snapshot of the default
  branch cloned on 2026-11-01; the upstream commit was not recorded. MD5
  `13828213408db1a6884887e14caebdcb`, 866470 bytes, 1048 lines.
- **Licence:** BSD-2-Clause Plus Patent, Copyright (C) 2020-2021 Michael Barnes.
  The full text is in `LICENSE.fisb-decode` next to this file. The fixture is
  redistributed unchanged.
- **What it is:** a test group generated by fisb-decode's author (not an RTCA
  test group). It has no expected outputs upstream.
- **Line format:** one uplink per line,
  `+<864 hex digits>;rs=<n>;rssi=<dBFS>;t=<unix seconds>.<ms>;` (dump978-fa
  raw format). The hex is the 432-byte post-FEC uplink payload. Timestamps are
  from October 2020. 85 lines start with `#` (generator comments such as
  `#  RECENTER 15 -> 1767 i:1167`), which a reader must skip. The other 963
  lines are uplinks.
- **Contents** (checked by `test_fisb_frame/fixture_tg30_parses`; see
  `docs/fisb-reference.md` §1.2, §2, §3 and §9):
  - Information frames: 6169 FIS-B APDUs (type 0), 17 Current Report Lists
    (type 14) and 46 service status frames (type 15).
  - APDUs by product ID: 8 NOTAM 421, 11 AIRMET 232, 12 SIGMET 20, 13 SUA 35,
    14 G-AIRMET 262, 63 NEXRAD regional 898, 64 NEXRAD CONUS 1087,
    70 icing low 369, 71 icing high 117, 84 cloud tops 714,
    90 turbulence low 440, 91 turbulence high 220, 103 lightning 100,
    413 generic text 1254. There are no products 15-17.
  - Time options: 5199 APDUs with T-opt 0 (hh:mm) and 970 with T-opt 2
    (mm/dd hh:mm). T-opts 1 and 3 do not appear.
  - Segmented APDUs: products 8 and 14 only.

## Related
